tvShow.name: The Shards
tvShow.overview: 17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: It's the summer of 1981 in Los Angeles; a series of disturbing crimes coincides with the arrival of a strange new student in Bret's orbit.

episodes.name: Don't You Want Me
episodes.overview: Bret digs deeper into Robert's murky past and uncovers shocking evidence.

episodes.name: Help Me! Rhonda
episodes.overview: A beloved student's sudden disappearance causes chaos for the senior class.

episodes.name: Robert's Party
episodes.overview: Susan's welcome party for Robert is overshadowed by a terrifying and violent incident.

episodes.name: Murder on the Dancefloor
episodes.overview: A televised dance competition culminates with a horrifying showstopper.

episodes.name: Homecoming (1)
episodes.overview: Troubled Debbie is galvanized by a new extracurricular.

episodes.name: Homecoming (2)
episodes.overview: A surprising Homecoming King and Queen are crowned as the Trawler's killing spree continues.

episodes.name: Hamlet
episodes.overview: Something turns rotten in the state of California, as two blackmail plots reveal two devastating secrets.

episodes.name: Stairway to Heaven
episodes.overview: With the city on lockdown, Debbie hosts a Halloween party that will change everything.

reviews.author: ChristlichenSoldaten
reviews.content: Campy light-hearted fun with extremely GORGEOUS people? It's not Shakespeare but thank you I love it 💗
